Seventh, if one sees [him] ascending a dais beneath a tree to receive the precepts.

Eighth, if one sees Buddha images displayed in rows and monks invited to receive offerings,
this is called the sign of the *dhyāna-vana* (meditation forest) *lākṣa*.
Ninth, if one sees a tree with blooming flowers entering meditative concentration,
this is called the "exhausting the forest" (kṣayavana) sign.
Tenth, if one sees a great king wandering about wearing a sword.

Eleventh, if one sees a king bathing his body and scattering fragrant powders upon clean garments,
this is called the sign of a *kalingara*.
